caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden object composed primarily of several planks and cylindrical rods, assembled to form a sturdy, three-legged bench-like structure. The main body is a long, thick, rectangular wooden plank with two cylindrical wooden legs attached at an angle on either end, forming a stable platform raised above the ground. At the center of the plank, there is a perpendicular assembly consisting of a shorter plank fixed vertically as a support, and a long, thinner board mounted at an angle above it, with a curved handle extending upward from the board's top. Beneath this angled board, another piece of wood acts as a footrest or pedal, attached by a visible pin, allowing it to pivot. The wood appears weathered, with a natural, light brown and grayish coloration and visible grain patterns, knots, and some signs of wear and aging. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or details, allowing the focus to remain on the wooden structure.
title: Wood Carver's Bench
